{{Quote|Most cordial greetings. I am Zan Threelow, Republic protocol officer. Welcome to Makeb and Keylander Station.|ZAN-3L0|<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />}}
'''ZAN-3LO''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that was stationed on [[Keylander Station]]. The droid assisted [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]] in enlisting the help of the Republic strike force during the time of the [[Conquest of Makeb]].<ref name="Trouble in Paradise" />
